due_when.clears_when: A run is OBSERVED grading at least one NON-BTC head -- read n_scored and the head ids in the report, never the run's conclusion. !! RE-SCOPING IS AN OPERATOR DECISION, NOT A SESSION'S: the open item's clears_when (b) puts 'fewer heads per run, or batched across runs' to the operator, and a session must not take it. !! A LONGER POLL IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY THE FIX -- at ~3.8 min/head the budget needed is ~84 min, which is a different trade against runner time. !! AND SHUFFLING THE ORDER WOULD BE THE WORST ANSWER: it would spread coverage while leaving every head partially graded, converting a visible, nameable gap into an invisible one.
